list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18 — enriched with kind, missable and story flags

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. Follow the roadmap below in order so nothing gets missed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Unmissable — it is the first story mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story, unmissable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story, unmissable.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story, unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story, unmissable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Story, unmissable — but do every missable in the roadmap BEFORE the finale.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story, unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Story, unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. Story, unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. Story, unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Story, unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Story, unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every mission, activity, collectible and challenge. Use the checklist and the roadmap's cleanup phase to mop up what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Jumps, near-misses and airtime all count — grind stunt jumps and traffic near-misses in free roam.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once: races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting, bowling and more. One of each.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Learn the weapon patterns, aim for headshots, and retry any challenge freely.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There is one race per location — win each once.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street, off-road and water races all count; a win in 20 distinct events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish at the marked spot and outscore Cal.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any arcade cabinet — finish one full game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's stranger strand.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's strand.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Follow the '?' markers on the map.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Find each meditation point and sit through the session.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track the marked rare animal and take it down cleanly.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find the cards scattered across Leonida and finish any three full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Photograph 100 marked spots with the in-game camera.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Any 50 of the game's challenges — races, stunts, shooting and collectibles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Do it during the story when the chance appears; after the finale it may not come back.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Chain three robberies in one run and keep the heat.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 distinct vehicles; the counter ticks on first entry.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and land five kills before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. When the airport sequence plays, leave by an unmarked route instead of the scripted one.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Kinda hot in these Rhinos. During the tank sequence, complete the Rhino objective — it only appears once.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, no wanted level.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Five separate vault heists — escape clean each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Intercept a truck, crack it, and get away.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named region on the map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. One per gang, all of them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Do it the first time you reach Ocean Beach; the moment may not repeat.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. During the showroom sequence, drive out through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a full game there when the moment comes.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — A partnership with mass appeal. Complete the partner activity the first time it is offered.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Choices made, for better or worse. A story choice locks this in — pick the bold option when the choice appears.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Second time's the charm. A one-time event: when it triggers, do it again immediately.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — What the hell just happened? A secret one-time encounter — follow the strange signal when it appears.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. During a bowling-alley drive-by, knock the pins over with a melee weapon from the vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Sell marked bills at your contacts until the total hits $250k.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and food all count.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the map.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app and register ten different vehicles.
